# Healthcare Leadership

This folder contains profiles of individuals holding senior medical and administrative leadership roles within the Danish regional healthcare system and clinical database governance structures. The currently indexed leader serves as a medical director and management representative for a regional hospital network, contributing to the steering committee of the national acute surgery database. Each page details the individual's institutional affiliations, governance roles, and direct citations from clinical registry reports.

## Pages

- [[lone-winther-jensen|Lone Winther Jensen]] — Medical Director and management representative for Region Midtjylland, serving on the acute surgery database steering committee.
